paite: Juda, Jesu Khrist sikha leh Jakob unau in, Pa Pathian sehtuam siangthoute leh Jesu Khrist a kep leh sap a omte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

paite: Zahngaihna, khamuanna leh itna na tung uah hihkhan in om hen.
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

paite: Deihtakte aw, i kikop hotdamna thu na kiang ua gelh teitei ka tup lai in, misiangthoute kiang a ginna khatvei kepsak a om thu a, phatuamngaitak a humbit a pang ding a hon hanthawn ding in, na kiang ua laigelh kiphamoh ahi chih ka na thei hi.
heading: Ginna Hutna
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

paite: Mi kuate hiam aguk a hong lut a-om ua, nidanglai a pan hiai siam louh tanna dia sehte; huaite'n thangtatna dia Pathian hehpihna kaikawi in, Toupa Pathian omsun leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist akitheihmohbawl behlap uhi.
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huan bangkim khatvei in thei vek mah le uchin, Toupa'n Aigupta gam a kipan mite asuahtaksak a, huai nung a gingtaloute ahihmanthatdan, nou hon theihsak nawn ka ut hi.
heading: Puksante
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

paite: Huan angelte, amau sawltak hihna zui lou a, a-omna ngei uh paisante ni thupi vaihawmna a ding a mial nuai a tangtawn gawtna a hen kawm in asit hi.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akiangnai ua khuate kingaihna a kipumpiak a, gitlouhna lek lua, amau mihinpihloute nangawn enlah a adelh tak ziak un, tangtawn mei a gawt a om dingte etsakna ding in suankhiak in a-om uhi.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

paite: Himahleh huaite'n leng huchibang mah in, hiai mite'n leng, mang a kinga in sa ahihthanghuai ua, thuneihna anial ua, thupina neite agense nak uhi.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

paite: Himahleh Mikael, angel tungnungpen in bawn, diabol toh kisel a, Mosi luang thu a akinak lai un atungthu gensak in amah agense ngam kei a, "Toupa'n hon tai zaw hen," achi zawta hi.
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

paite: Huai mite'n bel thil atheih louh peuh uh agensia ua, ngaihtuahna nei lou ganhingte bang a theihsiamna pianpih aneihte un, huai lam pang ah amau akihihsia uhi.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

paite: Atung uh agik hi! Kain lampi azui ua, punna delh in Balaam mohna ah atai ua, Korah thukalhna ah amangthangta uhi.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

paite: Hiaite ahi uh na itna ankuangluina ua hihmelhemtu leh lauhuai kiselte, amau mah kikhem, angsung ngaihtuah a, maingaltak a tathangte; meipi tuipai lou, huih mutlengte; phavang a singgah lou, nihvei sisa, azung toh bohkhiakte ahi uh.
heading: Puksante Tunggikna
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

paite: Tuipi kihot vonvon, amau zahlakna thankhia ahi ua; aksi vialvak, amau a dia tangtawn mial bing bikbek sitsakte ahi uh.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

paite: Huan Enok, Adam a kipan akhang sagihna in hiai mite tungtang ah, "Ngai un, Toupa amisiangthou sangsawmte toh ahong pai, chi in ana genkhol hi.
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

paite: Mi tengteng tung a vaihawm ding leh Pathian limsakloute tengteng Pathian limsaklouhna leh Pathian limsakloute tung a asep tengteng uah leh Pathian limsak lou mikhialte'n atung a thu khauhtak agen tengteng ua siam louh tangsak ding in," achi hi.
english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

paite: Huaite phunhatte leh ngohhatte ahi ua, amau utna bang zel in a-om ua, akamte un leng ki-otsakna thu agen gawpgawp ua, punna deih ziak in mite maitangphat adeih uhi.
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

paite: Himahleh deihtakte aw, nou zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist sawltakte'n thu agenkholhte uh theigige un.
heading: Vauna Leh Thuhilhna
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: "Hun nanung ah Pathian limsaklouhna lam a amau utna bang zel a om, nuihsan hatte ahong om ding uh," chih na kiang ua agendante uh.
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

paite: Hiai sa mite ahi, Kha nei lou, pawl tuam bawlte.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

paite: Himahleh deihtakte, nou zaw na ginna siangthou tung a noumau leh noumau kilemtou in; Kha Siangthou a thum in,
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

paite: tangtawn hinna neihsakna khop i Toupa Jesu Khrist zahngaihna ngak in, Pathian itna ah kikemhoih un.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

paite: Khenkhatte, ginglah a omte hehpih unla;
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

paite: khenkhatte, mei a kipan in lakhe zok unla, hondam un; khenkhatte, asa thanghuai banna uh puansilh lam leng kih in, lau kawm in hehpih un.
english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

paite: Tu in, na puklouhna ding ua hon veng thei leh athupina ma a nakpitak a nuamsa leh nin baang lou a noute hon koihtheipa,
heading: Phatna Leh Thumna
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

paite: apil omsun Hondampa, Pathian tak kia kiang ah, i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak in, hun himhim om ma leh tu leh tangtawn dong in pahtawina, leh thupina, leh vaihawmna, thuneihna omta hen, Amen.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
